links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease of ChatGPT-4 responses to family questions about cerebral palsy
links.effect: Mean FRE ranged from 31.47 ± 12.92 to 44.84 ± 17.39 across categories; many responses difficult for families to understand.
links.quote: FRE scores indicated that many responses were difficult for families to understand.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4 outputs to commonly asked patient/family questions about cerebral palsy rehabilitation using standardized scales for quality, reliability, and readability without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
